import json,random,ipaddress
random.seed(91)
initial=[["::/0",7]]

seen=set()

 x=random.getrandbits(128)
 if x in seen:continue
 seen.add(x);initial.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))+"/128",7])
bursts=[]
for b in range(256):
 aa=[]
 for _ in range(32):
  if random.random()<.5:
   x=random.getrandbits(128)
  else:x=0
  aa.append(str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x)))
 bursts.append({"version":0,"repeat":random.randint(1,1000000),"addresses":aa})
req={"cases":[{"initial":initial,"transactions":[],"bursts":bursts,"cache_pages":12,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":256,"decode":[0,1,2]}}]}
